2577-6797-7084-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-6797-7084-8345.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1436-2416-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1436-2416-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-2416-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Rise and Shine.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
1308-4094-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

3263-5413-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
3263-5413-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Trenching Steed.

338-4186-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4186-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

676-1987-5913.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1987-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1987-5913.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1987-5913.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2034-4013-5993.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Experimental Aviator.
When Experimental Aviator enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2279-3240-3967-6462.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

5361-7009-7638.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5361-7009-7638.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1594-4390-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
1594-4390-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

562-7070-7444.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Repeat.

2946-4050-7396.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4050-7396.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

560-2034-5220-6961-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
560-2034-5220-6961-7396.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

141-3967-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

2275-2604-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1850-4693-6701.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4693-6701.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

618-1938-6798.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1350-4010-5223-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-5223-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

252-1115-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-1115-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-3552-4785-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-4785-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

3967-4871-6291.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1789-5231-5649-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-5231-5649-5929.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

56-1417-4054-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-1417-4054-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-1417-4054-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1339-4279-5796.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4279-5796.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God and Starving Revenant trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Starving Revenant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2060-2510-2713-2717-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Krasis Incubation attached to Crystalline Crawler.
You have an enchantment card exiled by Semblance Anvil.
2060-2510-2713-2717-4772.description:
Activate Krasis Incubation by paying {G}{U} and returning it to your hand, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {G}{G}{U}{U}.
Cast Krasis Incubation by paying {G}{U} due to Semblance Anvil, attaching it to Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat.

1173-1984-2660-3454.manaNeeded: {R}{W} the first turn, with {6}{R}{R}{W}{W} available each extra turn
1173-1984-2660-3454.notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
1173-1984-2660-3454.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Final Fortune and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Final Fortune into your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, preventing you from losing the game this turn and shuffle Angel's Grace into your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
At the beginning of your end step, Final Fortune triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 4.

892-1548-1953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
892-1548-1953.description:
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Port Razer.
Move to your combat phase.
Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token and causing all creature tokens you control to become a copy of the Port Razer token.
Deal combat damage with any Port Razer token.
The Port Razer token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2436-3263-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Marwyn.
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn has a power of at least two.
2436-3263-3525.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat.

1030-2034-4894.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-2034-4894.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.
